labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Lazylibrarian is a program to follow authors and grab metadata for all your digital reading needs.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Lazylibrarian

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/unrar:latest AS unrar

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-ubuntu:noble

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG LAZYLIBRARIAN_COMMIT
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="chbmb"

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y \
    libjpeg-turbo8-dev \
    zlib1g-dev && \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apt-get install -y \
    ghostscript \
    libjpeg-turbo8 \
    libmagic1 \
    python3-venv \
    zlib1g && \
  echo "**** install app ****" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /app/lazylibrarian && \
  if [ -z ${LAZYLIBRARIAN_COMMIT+x} ]; then \
    LAZYLIBRARIAN_COMMIT=$(curl -sX GET "https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/9317860/repository/commits/master" \
      | jq -r '.id'); \
  fi && \
  echo "Installing from commit ${LAZYLIBRARIAN_COMMIT}" && \
  echo "${LAZYLIBRARIAN_COMMIT}" > /defaults/version.txt && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/lazylibrarian.tar.gz -L \
    "https://gitlab.com/LazyLibrarian/LazyLibrarian/-/archive/{$LAZYLIBRARIAN_COMMIT}/LazyLibrarian-{$LAZYLIBRARIAN_COMMIT}.tar.gz" && \
  tar xf \
    /tmp/lazylibrarian.tar.gz -C \
    /app/lazylibrarian --strip-components=1 && \
  cd /app/lazylibrarian && \
  python3 -m venv /lsiopy && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir \
    pip \
    wheel && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/ubuntu/ . && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/ubuntu/ Levenshtein && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get -y purge \
    libjpeg-turbo8-dev \
    zlib1g-dev && \
  apt-get -y autoremove && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /root/.cache

# add local files
COPY root/ /

# add unrar
COPY --from=unrar /usr/bin/unrar-ubuntu /usr/bin/unrar

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 5299
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-lazylibrarian-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# make folders
mkdir -p \
    /config/log \
    /config/cache \
    /downloads \
    /books

# copy config
if [[ ! -e /config/config.ini ]]; then
    cp /defaults/config.ini /config/config.ini
fi

# update version.txt
cp /defaults/version.txt /config/cache/version.txt

# permissions
lsiown -R abc:abc \
    /config

lsiown abc:abc \
    /downloads \
    /books

units.name: svc-lazylibrarian
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

exec \
    s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 5299" \
        s6-setuidgid abc python3 /app/lazylibrarian/LazyLibrarian.py \
        --datadir /config --nolaunch
